as_told.title: Cold War program buried; adversaries got crash retrievals and are ahead

plain: The United States and China are both said to have recovered crashed non-human craft and to be racing to copy how they work. The podcaster Joe Rogan relays this from Dan Farah, the filmmaker behind The Age of Disclosure, a documentary in which senior officials such as Marco Rubio, James Woolsey, James Clapper and John Brennan appear. Rogan says that "both the United States and China has retrieved these crashed vehicles and that they are also in this back engineering program," meaning taking them apart to learn the technology. A co-host named Jack, on an episode with the Navy scientist Salvatore Pais, tells a fuller version with reference to the witness David Grusch. He says the US program was buried after the Cold War, that rivals got craft either from their own crash recoveries or by infiltrating the American program, and that "now there is a race and we are not in first." If true, it would mean the secret is not only America's, and that the US may be falling behind.
